name: gap_continuation_momentum_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Stocks that gap up >1.5% at open AND continue higher in the first 15 minutes (close at bar 15 > open of bar 1) exhibit strong continuation momentum for the next 60-90 minutes. This is the opposite of gap fill — here the gap is GENUINE new information (earnings beat, upgrade, sector catalyst) and the first 15 minutes of upside confirm that the market is digesting the news positively with follow-through buying. The edge exists because most gap strategies focus on gap FILL (mean reversion), while gap CONTINUATION is the higher-edge trade when the gap has institutional backing. The 15-min confirmation period filters out dead-cat-bounce gaps. The inefficiency persists because distinguishing fillable gaps from continuation gaps requires monitoring volume profile and price action in the first 15 minutes.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 40 crore INR AND gap_pct > 1.5% AND gap_pct < 5%
session: 09:30-14:00 IST (enter after confirmation, ride through midday)

conditions: close > VWAP (above session VWAP after 15 min)
long.confirmation: close at bar 15 > high of first 5 bars (higher high after gap, not just drift)

short.confirmation: close at bar 15 < low of first 5 bars (lower low after gap, genuine sell pressure)

entry.entry_price: market order at 09:30 IST (after 15th 1-min bar from 09:15)

exit.target: 0.8% from entry (larger target — riding genuine momentum)
exit.stop_loss: VWAP (if price drops to VWAP, gap continuation thesis is broken) OR 0.5% from entry
exit.signal_exit: exit if close drops below EMA(close, 20) for 3 consecutive bars

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L; scale to 1.5L for earnings-driven gaps (highest conviction)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 25; high VIX = gaps may reverse
filters.time_filter: entry only after first 15 min (09:30); no new entries after 12:00
filters.trend_filter: prefer gaps in direction of NIFTY move (not contra-index)
filters.event_filter: distinguish between earnings gap (likely to continue) and sympathy gap (less likely)
other_filters: gap must be >1.5% to filter out noise; <5% to avoid parabolic extremes

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — gap continuation with 15-min filter is less commonly automated

weaknesses: Very low trade frequency — most days have 0 stocks meeting gap > 1.5% with continuation criteria
The 15-min wait means missing the initial post-gap move; entry price is already extended from the pre-gap level
Gaps on sympathy (sector peer had news, this stock gaps with it) tend to fade, and distinguishing from genuine gaps is imperfect
prior_art: Gap-and-Go strategy by Ross Cameron (Warrior Trading) is the closest prior art. Gap continuation is discussed by Pristine.com and in Bulkowski ('Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns'). The 15-min confirmation window is a standard day trading concept. Academic evidence on gap fills vs continuation: Trennepohl (1972), more recently Yuksel & Zaim (2017).
notes: Edge math: 0.52 * 80bps - 0.48 * 50bps = 41.6 - 24.0 = 17.6 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps (possibly 14 bps due to wider opening spreads). Net ≈ 3.6-6.6 bps per trade. One of the more promising strategies. Key challenge is frequency — may only trigger 2-3 times per week across the universe. Consider running across broader universe (BSE 500) to increase signal count.
